# Release Notes

> A template for documenting software releases. Copy this file for each new release and fill in the relevant details. Remove any sections that are not applicable to the current release.

---

## Version and Date

*Specify the release version (following [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/)) and the official release date.*

- **Version:** `vX.Y.Z`
- **Release Date:** `YYYY-MM-DD`
- **Release Type:** `Major | Minor | Patch`
- **Status:** `Stable | Beta | Release Candidate`

**Example:**

- **Version:** `v2.4.0`
- **Release Date:** `2025-01-15`
- **Release Type:** `Minor`
- **Status:** `Stable`

---

## Features

*List all new features and enhancements introduced in this release. Include a short description and, where helpful, link to the related issue, pull request, or documentation.*

**Format:** `- [Component] Description of the feature (#PR-number)`

**Examples:**

- **[Authentication]** Added support for single sign-on (SSO) via SAML 2.0. (#123)
- **[Dashboard]** Introduced a customizable widget layout for the analytics dashboard. (#145)
- **[API]** New `/v2/users/export` endpoint to bulk export user data in CSV format. (#152)

---

## Bug Fixes

*Document all resolved issues in this release. Reference the bug tracker ID or pull request when possible.*

**Format:** `- [Component] Description of the fix (#issue-number)`

**Examples:**

- **[UI]** Fixed an issue where the navigation menu would collapse unexpectedly on mobile devices. (#201)
- **[Database]** Resolved a race condition that could cause duplicate entries during concurrent writes. (#215)
- **[Auth]** Fixed a token expiration bug that caused premature session timeouts. (#222)

---

## Breaking Changes

*Note any changes that are not backward-compatible. Include migration instructions or links to upgrade guides to help users adapt.*

**Format:** `- [Component] Description of the breaking change — Migration guidance.`

**Examples:**

- **[API]** The deprecated `/v1/legacy-auth` endpoint has been removed. **Migration:** Use `/v2/auth` instead. See the [migration guide](https://example.com/docs/migrate-v2).
- **[Config]** Renamed environment variable `APP_SECRET_KEY` to `APP_SECRET`. **Migration:** Update your `.env` files and deployment configurations.
- **[SDK]** The `Client.connect()` method now returns a `Promise` instead of a callback. **Migration:** Refactor calls to use `async/await` or `.then()`.

---

## Acknowledgments

*Recognize the contributors, maintainers, and community members who helped make this release possible.*

**Format:** `- @github-handle — Contribution description`

**Examples:**

- **@janedoe** — Implemented the new SSO authentication flow.
- **@johnsmith** — Reported and helped diagnose the database race condition.
- **@contributor3** — Improved documentation and added translations for the French locale.

A special thank you to everyone who reported issues, submitted pull requests, and provided feedback during the development of this release. 🎉

---

*For questions or support, please open an issue on our [GitHub repository](https://example.com/repo) or contact the maintainers.*
